fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (18.5x on ~$4.55 NTM non-GAAP EPS at Sep-2027, a light haircut to FY3/28 consensus $4.58), FCF yield (5.2% on ~$4.52/sh FCF) and EV/EBITDA (16x ~$3.2B FY28 EBITDA less ~$3.8B Sep-2027 net debt), all on 575M non-GAAP diluted shares incl. the mandatory convertible preferred; blend ~$84.3, rounded to $85.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM non-GAAP EPS at Sep-2027 ~$4.55 (FY3/28 consensus $4.58, 25 analysts, range $4.08-$5.44, revenue $7.43B; bottom-up $7.4B rev, 65-66% GM, ~39-40% op margin, ~$180M interest, ~7.5-8% non-GAAP tax, 575M sh gives ~$4.40-4.55; roll-forward into FY29 offsets cycle haircut) x 18.5x (mid-cycle; between NXPI ~15x and ON ~24x; TXN/ADI ~28-32x; 10yr UST >5% caps multiple)

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: FY28 FCF ~$2.6B (~35% of ~$7.4B revenue, capex ~$100-150M) / 575M sh = ~$4.52/sh; required FCF yield 5.2% (lowered from 5.6%: peers ON ~4.9%, NXPI ~4.7%, plus ~50bp premium for leverage ~2.3x and cyclicality)

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: FY28 revenue ~$7.4B x ~43% adj. EBITDA margin = ~$3.2B; x16x = $51.2B EV; less net debt ~$3.8B at Sep-2027 ($5.09B Jun-2026 less ~$250-300M/qtr after ~$275M/qtr common+preferred dividends) = $47.4B / 575M sh = ~$82

bear.story: Upcycle matures by mid-2027 and the market starts pricing FY29 down: lead times normalize as outsourced capacity frees up, orders slow, price increases lapse, GM slides toward 61-62%, FY28 EPS ~$3.50, multiple ~15x with 10yr yields >5%; semis de-rate. Less likely near term given 25-day distributor inventory and flat 66-67% GM guide, so weight cut to 20%.

base.story: Recovery continues at slowing growth; FY28 revenue ~$7.2-7.5B, GM 65-66%, NTM EPS ~$4.55, net debt ~$3.8B and leverage <2x in sight, multiple ~18.5-19x. Data center (PCIe Gen6), aerospace/defense and industrial support growth.

bull.story: Extended multi-year upcycle (industrial + auto late recovery on top of AI data center), pricing sticks, EPS tracks high-end estimates ~$5.2+, deleveraging reopens buybacks, multiple re-rates to 22-23x as yields ease; retakes 52w high ~$103-106 and beyond.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$55 (~-30%, ~12x FY28 consensus EPS of $4.58) the market would be pricing a clear cyclical peak: book-to-bill below 1, a guidance cut with GM heading toward 60%, and distributor inventory rebuilding from 25 days. That is a failed recovery/deleveraging thesis, not rate-driven multiple noise. Below ~$62.5 the mandatory convertible also converts into more shares (up to ~29M below ~$51), adding dilution to a falling price.

reasoning: Round 2 revision after supervisor fact-check. Fundamentals: Jun-26 quarter sales $1.485B (+38% y/y), Sep-26 guide $1.603B mid (+40% y/y), EPS $0.91-0.95, GM 66-67%; strongest bookings in ~4 years continued through July-August across all units (Citi TMT, 2026-09-09). Supervisor corrections I accept: (1) my 'ordering inside lead time' late-cycle signal was overstated - CFO sees no double ordering, distributor inventory is lean at 25 days (decade range 17-43), internal lead times steady, lead-time stretch is at outsourced AI-constrained capacity; GM guided flat 66-67% through FY27. I therefore cut bear weight from 25% to 20% and raised bear price to $52. I keep a meaningful bear weight because my horizon ends Sep-2027, when the upcycle will be mature and the stock will trade on FY29 - the risk moves later rather than disappearing. (2) Net-debt paydown is ~$250-300M/qtr (June qtr ~$170M), so Sep-2027 net debt ~$3.8B not $3.6B, trimming EV/EBITDA by ~$0.5/sh. (3) Non-GAAP tax ~7.5% supports consensus $4.58 being achievable, so I lightened my EPS haircut ($4.60 NTM with haircut becomes ~$4.55 but on firmer footing). (4) Required FCF yield lowered to 5.2% vs peers ON 4.9%/NXPI 4.7%. Share count 574-575M confirmed. Net: fair value $84 -> $85, ~8% above spot $78.69 (analyst mean target ~$100-108 treated as optimistic evidence). Distribution: mixture of a main lognormal (median ~$89, sigma 0.39, weight 85%) and a cycle-turn component (median ~$60, sigma 0.38, weight 15%), giving a median ~$84.5 and P(>=79) 0.56; sigma below 50% realized vol (inflated by the 2025-26 rebound) but above a typical large-cap given beta ~1.7. Scenario mix 20/55/25 at $52/$86/$122 gives mean ~$88, consistent with a right-skewed lognormal around the $84-85 median. No option data used; research limited to 2 extra queries this round.
